title: Clock Tower
shortDescription: Patient gears count the hours beneath an empty bell frame.
longDescription:
The stair coils around a timber spine polished by generations of paws and hands. Brass gears turn with the solemn concentration of beetles; every seventh tooth has been painted blue by someone who clearly lost count.
Above the clock face hangs an empty bell frame. Wind moves through its ropes, but the deep humming comes from the timber beneath your feet.

fixtures.name: Empty Bell Frame
fixtures.examineDescription: The bell frame has neither bell nor clapper. Its ropes are dry and still. Pressing a hand to the supporting oak, you feel three slow pulses rise from below. Whatever makes the sound, it is not a bell swinging in this tower.
